{{Quote|I need you to go into a cave nearby and find creatures called Bone Gnashers. |Tori Radeen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bone Gnasher|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Tori Radeen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[biochemist]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Heh heh, you were lucky to get through those culstists. Make sure you return those glands to Tori.|[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to a spacer|<ref name="JDW" />}}
Tori Radeen was a biochemist<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> who operated out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:FT" /> She was known among [[Spy/Legends|spies]] for supplying some of the deadliest poisons in the galaxy.<ref name="JDW" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tori Radeen asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to go into the cave and bring her the poison glands of [[bone gnasher]]s that lived in the [[Krayt Cult Cave]]. She used the glands to create a new poison for use by Jabba.<ref name="SWG:BG" /><ref name="JDW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tori Radeen was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:FT" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Tori Radeen was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> In the game, she was involved in the quests "[[:w:c:swg:Find Tori|Find Tori]]" and "[[:w:c:swg:Bone Gnasher|Bone Gnasher]]" which were part of the "[[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the longest questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:FT" /><ref name="SWG:BG" /> These quests were featured in the web article [https://web.archive.org/web/20111124014341/http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/en_US/players/content.vm?page=Jabba%27s%20Dirty%20Work&resource=features "Jabba's Dirty Work"]<ref name="JDW" /> and in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG" /> However, for unknown reasons, the Mos Eisley section of the "Legacy Quest" was strongly revamped upon the release of the "[[:w:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3]]" update, on [[September 27]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> and Tori Radeen and her quests were eventually removed from the game.<ref name="SWG:FT" /><ref name="SWG:BG" />
